_comment: App registration for the review API (ADR 0009). Single tenant. Not applied by any script in this repository: see infra/entra/README.md. The role ids are fixed so that re-applying the file does not create duplicates.

oauth2PermissionScopes.adminConsentDescription: Lets the review UI call the claims review API as the signed-in handler.
oauth2PermissionScopes.userConsentDescription: Lets the review UI call the claims review API on your behalf.

appRoles.description: Reads the review queue, approves claims routed to a handler, and rejects any claim.
Everything a claims handler may do, and approves claims routed to senior review.
App-only. The intake pipeline reads the review history for the duplicate check.
